name: transform-three-phase-verify
hypothesis: Decompose transformational verification into three isolated phases (test logic on simple example, apply to full dataset, verify output matches spec) to catch errors early and extend check-execution discipline benefits for migration and format-conversion tasks.
prediction: migrate-format tasks improve from ~4/9 baseline to ~7-8/9; bugfix-inventory and feature-topwords maintain 2/2 performance.
